storyInfo: Deity Grypherburg holds a special hearing on the occupation of Katorga by a student group led by Sonya. Zoya appears as a witness and recalls the day when Student Assembly's decided to protest.

attributes.content: <p=1>Deity Grypherburg</><p=2>Early 1102</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.text: ...As much as we value the young, youth is never an excuse for crime and depravity.
In Ursus, children younger than them are already contributing to the empire in their respective ways; in the armies, in the factories, in the mines.
It is only the rich, spoiled students who cry foul at those who tell them to rein in their babbling mouths, as though Ursus would fall if they stopped talking for a moment.

They have never seen battle nor borne the weight of their comrades on their shoulders, yet they read their newspapers and play with their sandboxes and maps, dreaming of encirclements and flanking maneuvers, of 'victory at any cost'.

They have never spent a moment working the factories, or watching the desperate workers when a production line is halted in the middle of the night, yet they fool themselves with slogans like 'double the pay, double the production'.
They flock into the birch forests, writing sorry poems that would have you believe their lives were more pathetic than the miners of the Far North.

Their views are based on their shallow understanding of the land around them. They appropriate the words of their forebears to support their fallacies, repeating themselves over and over to convince those foolish enough to hold such views.
The only mistake of this council is its continued indulgence and restraint. It has gained nothing but their scorn and hatred, and birthed these outcomes.
I maintain that this hearing is completely redundant, because the nature of the incident at issue is clear.
The students are attempting to undermine Ursine order. They have taken up arms and broken down the walls of the containment zone. This is no less than premediated insurrection.

attributes.name: Scathing Noble
attributes.content: As for their 'leader', this so-called 'The General'—

attributes.name: Scathing Noble
attributes.content: —This Sonya Mikhailivna.
She is a traitor to Ursus, plain and simple.
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: Your opinion is respected, Count Yusupov, but we cannot make a determination as to these students until the hearing is concluded.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I will once again remind all present that the outcome of this hearing will define the Katorga Incident.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: This atrocity that took place in our magnificent Grypherburg must be judged fairly and solemnly.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: And we must ensure a fair outcome for the future of Ursus, these students living in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Your Honor, I must remind you before we begin...
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: The actions of these students that currently stand outside the council building have tarnished the dignity of Ursus.
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: The emblem of our empire hangs above your head. It reminds us all from whence the glory of Ursus arises, the glory in which all her people bathe.
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: As the Grypherburg of old belongs likewise to the emperors of old, the present and future belong to His Reigning Majesty, and to all of us who execute Ursus's will on his behalf.
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: If we fail to try Sonya Mykhailivna and her accomplices for treason, we are handing the future over to the lazy, unproductive dregs of society.
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: How, then, could Ursus hold her head high upon this land? How could His Imperial Majesty's justice be upheld?
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: Justice? How dare you speak of His Majesty's justice?
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: No lawyers, no prosecutors, no juries... the motion to establish a statute has been on the agenda for more than a decade. The old guard like you are the only reason it hasn't been passed!
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: And what have the new blood like you done for the empire? You've bought your titles with chervontsy, yet you consort with traitors...
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: How dare you adorn your chest with the medals conferred upon you by His Imperial Majesty, when you step up from those protesting students outside to wax lyrical here. Have you no shame?
attributes.name: Scathing Noble

attributes.content: Meanwhile, outside the council building.
Damned kids...
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: He was supposed to be off-duty today.
That is, until he got an urgent call while sleeping in his room, and was told that students from all over Grypherburg are on the streets, blocking every route to the council building.
He and his colleagues mobilized for war, yet when they came on the scene...
They found no flags, no shouting, only students standing on the streets quietly.
They give way when police or officials show up, allowing them to enter the 'siege'.
...Huh?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Stop right there! What are you doing?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Remain calm, sir. We mean no disrespect. We're only here to support our fellow students.
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: But some dignitaries have promised to speak at the hearing, and now they are nowhere to be seen.
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: May I ask if the police have them in custody? We can't allow the hearing to begin without them—
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: I don't know what you're talking about! This is none of your business!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Now, get back!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Where are our people? Why are there so many absences?
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: Have the old fools detained our witnesses to give themselves an advantage?
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: Order!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The police have been mobilized to maintain order in Grypherburg, given the circumstances. Traffic disruption may cause delays.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: However, this matter can permit no further delay. While you were arguing, our first witnessed arrived.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The bickering belligerents turn to the door, their anger replaced with curiosity as they watch the Ursus woman enter the hall.
Please take your seats. Let the proceedings commence, in the name of His Imperial Majesty's justice...
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Witness, proceed to the stand.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: This is a friend of Sonya Mykhailivna?
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: Yes. They say the new nobility vouched for her. As long as she plays her part and testifies as agreed, her friend will get off easy.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: But that's not the outcome we want to see...
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: Relax. I want to see how much weight these commoners' words carry.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: Thank you for testifying, Young Zoya.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I'm sure you have noticed the police equipment that Zoya carries.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Her father was a respected Ursine policeman, who gave his life at Chernobog to protect the empire's order. I am sure she carries on her father's loyalty to the land.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: As an eyewitness to the Katorga Incident, she was questioned several days ago, and submitted a report regarding the matter.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The committee will now read the report and cross-examine the witness. I believe this report will give all of us a better understanding of the Katorga Incident.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Young Zoya, do you attest to the truthfulness of this document, and to the statements that you will give at this hearing?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I do, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Your Honor, we request the hearing be postponed.
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: Young Zoya's guarantor, Baron Kamshalov, has not yet arrived. The baron's honor is at stake when she testifies. She must not be allowed to do so in his absence.
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: Hah, everyone knows Baron Kamshalov likes to sleep in. Are we to postpone the hearing permanently, when he never wakes up?
attributes.name: Unconcerned Noble

attributes.content: I am unaware that he has any such habit.
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: You think his casinos operate in the daylight? He does his business late at night.
attributes.name: Unconcerned Noble

attributes.content: You may both be barons now, but he had already made more money than you will in two lifetimes by the time you were just a private in the army.
attributes.name: Unconcerned Noble

attributes.content: But he wasn't there last night—
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: Someone beside him grabs him, and he stops himself mid-sentence, sweating profusely from his forehead. He can hardly admit in public that he and other friends in high places spent last night in an illegal casino.
Oh?
attributes.name: Unconcerned Noble

attributes.content: If he wasn't at the casino last night, maybe you should ask your wife—
attributes.name: Unconcerned Noble

attributes.content: Say that again, mudak!
attributes.name: Noble Beneath Podium

attributes.content: The furious noble jumps across a few rows of seats to get at the other.
Police! Separate them!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The arbiter's shouting ignites a council hall that was already on the brink of inferno, with several who were already arguing joining the fray.
The few policemen in the room walk up and motion to try to separate them, but stop short of touching anyone. All the belligerents are too important for them to risk angering.

Absinthe closes her eyes and touches the back of her neck. For a moment there, she thinks it might be the air stirred by the swinging of fists that is making her feel cold, not the behavior of the nobles once again going beyond the pale.
In her mind, she seems to hear the words that every person in Ursus has heard a thousand times.

attributes.text: You're the reason Ursus is what it is!

attributes.content: ...You're the reason Ursus is what it is!
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: So much the better! Do we dare to imagine the empire if you were guiding her?
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: They grab each other by the collar, while the onlooking students seem to have no intention of stopping then, instead cheering them on in eager anticipation of a good show.
Several students sit quietly in the rear, away from the crowd.
*Sigh*...
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Is Sonya not here yet?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Reviewing the correspondence, Sonya should be here this afternoon, and Instructor Dur-nar tomorrow.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: But the discussion has meandered onto a tangent. Should we intervene before things get out of hand?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: We're participating in a student gathering under the banner of the Ursus Student Self-Government Group, with Sonya as our leader. I doubt anyone will listen to us without her present.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Besides, the issues being discussed here are important. We need her to make decisions.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: But I recall that Sonya did not part on the best of terms with Olga's group—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: That's the last honey drop, Leto!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: You're the kindest and sweetest, Gummy. Maybe there's another hidden somewhere in your pocket?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Don't pick on Gummy over a piece of candy, Leto.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: It's because you wouldn't let me drink honey... I haven't had a sip since I got back to Ursus.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I should've stayed in Kjerag.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We're not here on vacation... you can have all the honey you want once we complete our mission from the Grypherburg office, or when you stop getting honey drunk.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Boooooring...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: You sure you don't want to watch them fight, Leto? I thought you of all people would be excited.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I like fighting, but I don't care about two dunces slugging it out. They talk about helping people, but the first thing they do is punch the people who are supposed to help them.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Hm? Looks like the one in charge has finally had enough.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: People... people! That's enough!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: The golden-haired Ursus screams at the top of her lungs, but her anxious, trembling voice sounds thin and weak amidst the cheers and angry shouts.
People... let's set these pointless arguments aside. Don't forget why we're here today.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Rania is a Grypherburg student. He's one of us, our friend, and he has been treated unjustly because of an act of justice.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I am only so strong alone, but there must be something that the combined strength of the Student Assembly can do, to make the capital hear our voices.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Let's calm down, and work out a plan to free our friend from prison.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: No point in discussing the big picture with a bunch of meat heads.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Rania's actions were reckless. Did he not think through the consequences when he vandalized the council hall?
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: You hear them, Olga? The Symposium doesn't want to help Rania. They are defeatists who keep using the 'big picture' as an excuse to shirk their responsibilities.
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: Rania is your friend and a member of the Petrachevsky Group, but the Vanguards have always been on your side.
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: Meanwhile, this coward's grandfather might have been an honorary captain in the old Emperor's Imperial Guard, but he has none of the spirit of an Ursus soldier!
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: The Symposium is of one mind with you, Olga. We have never opposed rescuing Rania and the other detained students, and we do not even oppose the use of force when necessary.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Meanwhile, what do these Vanguards think their crude, barbaric actions would actually serve to achieve when it comes to changing our country?
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: The Revitalization of Ursus makes it clear that the empire is not an old jacket you can simply swap out for a new one.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: That damnable Nikola Ilyinsky again...
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: I would be happy to hear the Symposium out, if you have any better ideas.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: We must print more newspapers, highlighting the injustices Rania and his comrades have suffered.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Not just in the academies; we have to mobilize the citizenry as well. Rania was arrested for speaking up for the miners of the Far North. The workers will stand on our side.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: We will attract sympathizers by publicizing the plight of the arrested students, we will teach them why we struggle, and how to struggle. We will target the legacy of Hippogryphs.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: The old nobles of Ursus gladly accepted the brutal traditions of the Hippogryph Kingdom. Many of them have Hippogryph blood in their veins.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Only by excising these centuries-old tumors can Ursus truly belong to the Ursus.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: What a joke. Do these 'old nobles' include the House of Treplev? Are you going to excise Olga like a tumor?
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: That is another matter entirely. As long as they support a new Ursus—
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Then you tell the burghers and workers that Nikola Ilyinsky never proposed overthrowing the regime, only how to sell himself for a good price afterwards.
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: And then you tell the Liberi and Felines among them that Ursus belongs to the Ursus, and all other races are either our servants or spies.
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: You're taking things out of context! He never said anything of the sort.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: The only thing the old tsar did right was hang this madman who kept babbling about a 'new Ursine identity'!
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: A student beneath the podium throws a metal water can at the Vanguards member, but it misses and hits the stage instead.
Other Vanguards immediately grab him and start beating him up, once again engulfing the scene in chaos.
Hey, these guys don't call themselves Vanguards for nothing. They fight a little better, relatively speaking.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: The ruckus is making it impossible for Absinthe to respond to Leto's joke. She glances at Olga, who is supposed to be in charge.
Olga stands quietly with hesitation on her face, looking at the members of the Self-Government Group, the only ones who have not involved themselves in the clash.
...We have new problems.
attributes.name: Vanguards Member

attributes.content: Punches freeze in mid-air and the shouting ceases. The brawling students let go of each other.
General!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: You're late again, Sonya.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: ...Sorry.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But it looks like I'm here just in time.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You were late for the last general meeting. Need I remind you that a general meeting of the Student Assembly represents—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: A major event that will determine the future of Grypherburg's students. I remember. Go on, keep 'talking'.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Why so quiet, Faddey? I thought you liked greeting people with your fists, including me.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Not like that'd achieve anything.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: No, but talking with your fists always guarantees a result better than talking with your mouth.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It's true that today's agenda has not advanced smoothly. But that doesn't excuse the Self-Government Group's repeated contempt for the Student Assembly.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Excuse me, Chairman Trepleva, but what exactly do you mean by 'contempt'?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: The Self-Government Group has followed the Assembly's rules to the letter and participated in all activities since we joined.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Everyone turns to look at Zima.

This general meeting is being held on short notice, while many of the Self-Government Group's members have missions abroad. I find it unfair that you are accusing us of contempt simply for being late.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Most importantly, the Self-Government Group has never been party to the Assembly's internal conflicts.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: If I may be blunt, it seems the Self-Government Group has respected the Assembly to a greater extent than any of the student organizations arguing and fighting in this room.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: If I may be blunt, Anna, you were never supposed to be part of the Assembly.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: Your organization and its members are from Chernobog, while we are all Grypherburgers.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: I remind you that it was Olga who extended an invitation to the Self-Government Group to join the Assembly.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Olga wanted the Assembly to unite as many students as possible. That's why she took you in, and provided assistance for you to establish a base in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: In turn, you are expected to demonstrate an eagerness to contribute to the Assembly, or at the very least, to respect it.
attributes.name: Symposium Member

attributes.content: We have not forgotten the help that we received, and we express our gratitude for it, Leonid.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: The Self-Government Group has always been supportive of the Assembly's activities. We have never backed down, nor compromised your plans.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: What did you do when the assembly instructed you to burn the tsar's portrait?
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: We upgraded the portrait to a scrawling of the tsar's family. Something wrong with that?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Whose scrawling was it?
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: Mine, hehe.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: It was my first time. Everyone loved it!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: That's the problem!
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: How do you expect to provoke anti-tsarist sentiment when you draw the tsar's family so cute?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: So the problem is she draws too good? You couldn't catch her if you practiced three years!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Suka! You're just looking for trouble!
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: That's enough! Stop—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: ...Order! This is a hearing, a solemn occasion. We will tolerate no disruptions.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Absinthe wakes from her reverie. The nobles have reached a truce, though they continue to glare at each other, their fine outfits not looking so fine anymore.
Very well. Let us return to your background, Young Zoya.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: You mentioned the Student Assembly, an organization that I'm sure most of us are familiar with.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: It is an alliance of student organizations from various schools, often publishing commentary under pseudonyms inspired by famous traitors, such as the wicked Ivan Tulin
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Hey... who is this Ivan Tulin
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: Younger brother of the great traitor Yakov Petrov, who wrote several seditious volumes while in exile in Leithanien.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: The council has investigated, but he hasn't been seen in public for a while, and he hasn't published anything new in some time, so he's probably dead.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: Why use the name of a dead man?
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: All these conspiracies and outlandish claims need a representative opposed to His Imperial Majesty, preferably someone who cannot personally rebuke them.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: They all want Ivan dead more than we do, so that they might claim the name.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: You said you personally witnessed the meeting of this Student Assembly as a spectator before the incident?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I should make it clear that I was not a member of any student organization; I attended as a friend of Sonya's, and others.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I do not have full knowledge of the outcome of their discussions, and I never supported their actions.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Hmm...
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Parliamentarian, pass me the document to your left.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: This transcript indicates that the Student Assembly was planning some kind of action against the Grypherburg Winter Ball.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: That's enough... we've wasted too much time already. We must get back to the agenda at hand—how to rescue Rania and his comrades.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Faddey, you are the Vanguards' representative. What is your final proposal?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: We’ve deliberated fully. A raid on the prison.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: While Rania's arrest was a high-profile one, we have learned that his prison is not heavily guarded.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Besides, the annual ball presents a waning of Grypherburg's security. It's the perfect opportunity.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: You're out of your mind!
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: (Whisper) Wouldn't the police be extra careful with all the nobles gathered during the ball?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: (Whisper) Father said the Grypherburg police are not selected by the law, but appointed by the powerful.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: (Whisper) Both the armies and the police are part of the Ursus Guard. Minor nobles who don't have the influence to send their children into the Army as officers take the second-best option of sending them into the police to 'gain experience'.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: (Whisper) The Winter Ball is more than just a social event; it's also the stage of politics and intrigue for all the assembled nobility.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: (Whisper) Personnel moves in the police normally take place before and after the ball, which will keep the officials busy.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: (Whisper) And so, Faddey is not necessarily wrong.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You're proposing an act of war, Faddey, while I'm not sure you can even wield a weapon, nor have I seen any preparation from your party.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Of course we're prepared.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: This is for present company only, but I will tell you that I know some free traders who can get us used weapons from the Londinium war, enough to arm us all.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Free traders? Those foreigners?
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: Is that enough to face down heavily-armed prison guards?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Of course! If you've seen them with your own eyes, you know that they're decades ahead of Ursine technology.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: We're falling behind. Survival of the fittest is the law of nature. This is our last chance to catch up.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: We must not allow the old, corrupt aristocrats to drag the empire into its grave. We will be the vanguard that makes Ursus strong again.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: And you think these 'free traders' do it out of the goodness of their hearts? Have you forgotten that we are Ursines first and foremost?
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: You would have us take up foreign weapons and follow the corrupt institutions of Victoria and Columbia! I will not stand idly by while people like you—
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: He steps forward as he shouts, trying to prove the Symposium are just as physically capable.
Someone grabs his right arm. He tries to shake off the hand, only to find that it does not budge in the slightest.
Leonid turns around to curse the interloper, only for his gaze to meet Zima's.
Are you done?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Faddey, your plan is just sending people to die. No intel, no tactics, no info on whether the weapons are any good.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The police will be a little mixed up, but the prison is defended by trained gendarmes that we can't handle.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I know you can fight, Sonya. Many of us Vanguards have great respect for you.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: But your talk of 'ready' is no different from the Symposium's 'big picture', both excuses for inaction.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Do not interfere with the Assembly's decision, if you don't have a better way to get Rania and his comrades out.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Do not presume to represent the Assembly's decision without a general vote, Faddey.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: The Symposium is clearly not on your side, and the Self-Government Group will not support a suicide mission. We can take a vote now, if you really think your words are enough to sway the majority.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: All eyes are on Olga, filled with hope and expectation.
Olga, if there are no objections, the Petrachevsky Group can count the votes as usual—
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Olga?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: I agree with Leonid and Sonya. The Assembly cannot risk a failed violent struggle.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: But I also agree that simply sitting around will only make matters worse, sapping our will to resist while giving the police the chance to do as they please with Rania.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Therefore, I have a plan that will satisfy everyone and rescue Rania. We will encircle the Winter Ball.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: What is she talking about? Instead of raiding the prison, we go straight for the nobles?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: No, this is not an act of violence.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: We will go unarmed. We will protest with signs in our hands and tell the nobles about the people who are undermining our nation's future behind our backs.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I don't see the point in it.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Your father may be a good man, Olga, but that doesn't mean all the nobility are willing to sit and talk with us.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Even setting aside everything they've done over the years, they have arrested Rania and his comrades, and they're talking about making a public example of them.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You would simply yell at them, empty-handed and defenseless...? This is like putting a plate of fresh meat out for a mangler, cut to bite-sized pieces for the beast's convenience.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: No, Anna, you don't understand. The nobles at the ball have no reason to harm us.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I've organized similar events in the past. As long as we exercise restraint, neither the nobles nor the police will lay hands on us.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: In the name of my father, I promise that this is simply an action to make our voices heard. No one will get hurt.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I agree with Olga. Many of our number come from the local aristocracy. In effect, we will be holding ourselves hostage against the aristocratic class as a whole.
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: It's one of the few chips that we truly hold in our own hands. With enough of us, it's very possible that we can sway the council's decision.
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: A compromise, but better than inaction... the Vanguards assent.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Let us take the vote.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: It is hereby proposed that all the constituent organizations of Student Assembly march upon the venue and protest before the nobility at seven o'clock in the evening, three days from now, during the Winter Ball.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Hands raise into the air... before long, there are a few outsiders at the meeting, just as there were during the brawl.
The students with their hands raised look so tall, their calm giving them strength.
Absinthe is short of breath. She scans their faces, but finds no reassurance in them.
Some desire action, their eyes filled with anger, their hands trembling with guilt towards their fellow students and hatred for the establishment.
Some fear violence, embracing this alternative, believing that someone will back them up as long as they do not raise steel, relieved smiles on their faces.
Others are worried. They wish to be accepted, fearing rejection by an organization that represents passion and progress. They have raised their palms above their ears, docile and obedient...
...Get away from Sonya!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: The outcome is clear, Sonya. The vast majority agree with the proposal.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I hope the Self-Government Group will join in this action. The Assembly needs everyone.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: The votes in favor don't change the fact that this is an ill-considered... ill-advised proposal.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You think you're smarter than us, Anna? We know the SSG has been paying lip service to the Assembly, we simply chose not to say it out loud!
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: The SSG needs to prove its loyalty to the Assembly. Enough of your arrogance, Chernobogian.
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: You want a fight, I'll give you one!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Leto! No!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: The Self-Government Group has been utterly committed to finding the best way for all students.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Our doctrine is flexibility, as we have explained to you many times. It is most unfair to criticize the SSG's position now.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Natalya of House Rostov, you may not be a soldier, but you are Ursine nobility, and you should know that obedience is the foundation of our nation's battlefield dominance.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: But—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I'll go.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya...?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I'm glad you accept the Assembly's ideals, Sonya.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I'll go, and I'll join your action, Olga, on one condition.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Any student who refuses to participate is free to pull out without compromising their future status in the Assembly.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Phew... glad that's over.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Dealing with those noble kids is such a headache... brr, Grypherburg nights are awfully cold.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I'll block the wind for you, Leto!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Thanks, Gummy!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Aha! Got it! C'mere, honey drop!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Hey! That wasn't nice!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: YOU were the one who lied to me about running out of honey drops!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Sonya...?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Sorry I made that call for you all, without asking.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That's not what I meant...
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Why apologize, Sonya? You didn't decide anything for us. We chose to join you.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Besides, falling out with the Assembly back there would only make things more difficult for our subsequent operations.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You're always trying to do the right thing. We trust you.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Natalya is right... but did you agree to Olga's proposal to get the SSG out of a tight spot, or do you genuinely support her action?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: They're rushing into this without planning anything. I'm worried it's gonna get out of hand.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We're Rhodes Island-trained. If anything unexpected happens, we can help.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I support you too, Sonya.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I'm just thinking...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Why did we come back to Ursus?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Because Rhodes Island doesn't have an office in Ursus, and they need the Self-Government Group to establish an information network here.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: But we could've helped Rhodes Island in other ways. It's not like we've done anything but a little support work since we got to Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We talked about this before we left Rhodes Island. We agreed that the SSG should fight for an office in Ursus.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The Doctor was a little iffy on it, but eventually said yes...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I guess the Doctor wants us to go back to a normal life.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: But... this isn't the normal life I imagined...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Everyone's fighting all the time. I don't get hungry, but I'm never happy.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: That much is true. Everyone we've met is the same. They keep blather on with big words and concepts, without actually understanding anything.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Is it because we don't know Grypherburg well enough, or because of our unwillingness to reach out to others?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Maybe we've just been away from Ursus for too long. We need time...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: We never truly left Chernobog, did we?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Their faces reflect faintly in the shop windows by the roadside under the dim street lamps. Winter nights in Deity Grypherburg are long and quiet.
They walk old stone-paved streets, trampling chunks of snow into the dirt-filled gaps.
We should have gone back to say goodbye to that old, lifeless place.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If we keep running from it, the Ursus we remember is just gonna stay charred dirt under broken rubble... And I can't call that home.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It is the empire's past. It will be the empire's future, if we do nothing.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: The Self-Government Group has seen the fire, while the rest of Ursus has not. We should find the best way forward, however slim the chance may be.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: We need friends to get ourselves set up in Grypherburg. That's why we joined the Assembly in the first place.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I wanna help our new friends!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Hah. Besides, the SSG never backs down.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Damn straight!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Are you alright, Zoya?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...Young Zoya? Young Zoya!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Are you listening?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I find myself fighting my emotions as I relive the events of the general meeting. It was a difficult time for me.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Entirely understandable.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I'm sure that all present know the background of the Katorga Incident, but I would like you to describe again the circumstances surrounding the Winter Ball at the start of the incident.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Yes, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I spoke to attendees at the ball, and some students who participated in the action shortly after the end of the ball.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I learned that certain unexpected events took place on the day of the ball—
attributes.name: Absinthe
